These days, people think of the Ivory Tower as a research institute, but did you know it was once a powerful political entity that practically controlled the entire continent? Where do you think the knowledge and secrets our founders accu…

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30164-1.htm.text: Trader Ian: Tell me what you need.

merchant/30164-pk.htm.text: Trader Ian: How did you get past the guards? The quality of their training must be slipping... I don't like this at all!

Q00033_MakeAPairOfDressShoes/30164-01.ht.text: Trader Ian: Come in! What can I do for you? Ah yes, a payment from Woodley! That's 300,000 Adena, right?

Q00033_MakeAPairOfDressShoes/30164-04.ht.text: Trader Ian: You haven't seen Mr. Woodley? When you do, tell him that I'll accept his payment this time, but next time he's late, I'll charge him a late fee.

Q00033_MakeAPairOfDressShoes/30164-02.ht.text: Trader Ian: Humph! Only 300,000 Adena for the excellent item I made for him? I suppose I'll accept it this time! Tell Mr. Woodley that his balance is paid off, but next time, I'll have to charge a late fee!

Q00033_MakeAPairOfDressShoes/30164-03.ht.text: Trader Ian: So, Mr. Woodley sent you? Where is his payment? Did you drop it by any chance? Please check your pockets!
